factcheck.claim: Descript Hobbyist is $16/mo billed yearly ($24 monthly), Creator is $24/mo billed yearly ($35 monthly), and Business is $50/mo billed yearly ($65 monthly) as of November 1, 2026.

CapCut Pro is $19.99/mo or $179.99/year, Ultra is $79/mo or $900/year, Teams is $12.49/seat/mo as of October-November 2026 following the July 2026 pricing restructure that removed the $9.99 Standard tier.
CapCut auto captions moved behind the Pro paywall during the 2025-2026 pricing restructure (previously available on free tier).
Descript Free offers 60 minutes of media per month, 720p export, watermark, and 100 one-time AI credits.
CapCut remains available in the US under the TikTok USDS Joint Venture structure announced January 23, 2026, which also covers Lemon8.
